summary: A reply that quotes a message further back than the transcript window is no longer misread as an unrelated new message.
details: Live symptom: a reply quoted a message 56 rows back against context_window=40; the parent fell out of the window, and Nora attributed the reply to the wrong topic until corrected directly.

The window now grows to reach a quoted parent (plus a configurable margin, capped by a configurable multiple of the normal window) instead of rendering the reply unthreaded; beyond the cap the reply still renders exactly as it did before.
Fixed on both the tag/reply path and the fire path's participation turns, through one shared resolver rather than two copies.
A reply whose quote still cannot be resolved at all (pruned, pre-migration, a foreign conversation) is unaffected.
limitations: A reply whose quote is beyond the configured cap still gives no cue that anything was skipped.
